hebrewText: רָנִּי֙ בַּת צִיּ֔וֹן הָרִ֖יעוּ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל שִׂמְחִ֤י וְ/עָלְזִי֙ בְּ/כָל לֵ֔ב בַּ֖ת יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם

tokens.bdb: properly, to creak (or emit a stridulous sound), i.e. to shout (usually for joy)
tokens.kjv: aloud for joy, cry out, be joyful (greatly, make to) rejoice, (cause to) shout (for joy), (cause to) sing (aloud, for joy, out), triumph.

tokens.bdb: a daughter (used in the same wide sense as other terms of relationship, literally and figuratively)
tokens.kjv: apple (of the eye), branch, company, daughter, [idiom] first, [idiom] old, [phrase] owl, town, village.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a daughter (used in the same wide sense as other terms of relationship
tokens.enLiteralWord: a daughter (used in the same wide sense as other terms of relationship

tokens.explanationEn: a daughter (used in the same wide sense as other terms of relationship

tokens.bdb: Tsijon (as a permanent capital), a mountain of Jerusalem
to mar (especially by breaking); figuratively, to split the ears (with sound), i.e. shout (for alarm or joy)
tokens.kjv: blow an alarm, cry (alarm, aloud, out), destroy, make a joyful noise, smart, shout (for joy), sound an alarm, triumph.

tokens.bdb: Jisrael, a symbolical name of Jacob; also (typically) of his posterity
probably to brighten up, i.e. (figuratively) be (causatively, make) blithe or gleesome
tokens.kjv: cheer up, be (make) glad, (have, make) joy(-ful), be (make) merry, (cause to, make to) rejoice, [idiom] very.

tokens.bdb: to jump for joy, i.e. exult
properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
tokens.kjv: (in) all (manner, (ye)), altogether, any (manner), enough, every (one, place, thing), howsoever, as many as, (no-) thing, ought, whatsoever, (the) whole, whoso(-ever).

tokens.bdb: the heart; also used (figuratively) very widely for the feelings, the will and even the intellect; likewise for the centre of anything
tokens.kjv: [phrase] care for, comfortably, consent, [idiom] considered, courag(-eous), friend(-ly), ((broken-), (hard-), (merry-), (stiff-), (stout-), double) heart(-ed), [idiom] heed, [idiom] I, kindly, midst, mind(-ed), [idiom] regard(-ed), [idiom] themselves, [idiom] unawares, understanding, [idiom] well, willingly, wisdom.
